newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman raises Guardian Royal, CU.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Goldman raises Guardian Royal, CU.

text.p: British insurers Guardian Royal Exchange and Commercial Union Plc were raised to "trading buy" from "market outperform" at Goldman Sachs, the investment bank said on Friday.
Royal & Sun Alliance Insurance Group Plc was upgraded to its "top European priority list" from "market outperformer", Goldman analyst Stephen Dias said earlier.
He lifted current year pre-tax figures for Royal & Sun to 870 million stg from 850 million and for 1998 to one billion stg from 970 million.
"It's among the best European ideas we've got," said Dias.

"We believe the merger (of Royal Insurance and Sun Alliance) is not just about cost cutting but positioning the whole company powerfully for the future. UK insurers look quite cheap and this is a big call on the whole sector," he said.
By 1024 GMT, Royal & Sun shares were up 18-1/2p at 507p, Commercial Union slipped 1/2p to 683-1/2p and Guardian Royal rose 5-1/2p to 300p.
